pages.text: GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS FOR TWIN PIRATE GUN INSTALLATION - ~- Remove each rifle assembly from shipping carton and install as per enclosed drawing. - Attach four cabinet levelers to bottom of cabinet. The power is controlled by a switch located on top of the cabinet. Plug line cord into A.C. only, 60 cycles, 115 volts. VOLTAGE CONTROL - - In low line areas (100 volts or less), an additional boost in the 50 volt output of the transformer may be obtained by removing the wire from the 50 volt position of the trans- former, and rewiring to the 55 volt position. 25¢ JACK - - Located on back door to control 1, 2, or 3 plays for a quarter. EXTENDED PLAY JACK - - Located on back door to give either extended play (additional units of time), or 1 replay. TOP SCORE CONTROL JACK - - Located on back door and is adjustable from conservative (highest score values), to liberal (lowest score values). TIME CONTROL JACK - - Located on back door and is adjustable from 30 to 50 time units. SOUND VOLUME CONTROLS - - Located on Amplifier Unit (P.C. 569-907). To increase volume, rotate controls as indicated by arrows on Amplifier Unit. PHOTOCELL SENSITIVITY CONTROLS - r - Located on Photocell Detector Unit (P.C. 569-921). To increase sensitivity of each target, rotate controls as indicated by arrows on Dectector Unit. TRIGGER CONTROL SLIDE SWITCH - - Located on back door. In 'ON' position, each trigger must be released after every shot (single shot operation). In 'OFF' position, trigger may be held in a depressed state (rapid fire). MIDWAY MFG.
